issues.suggestedTurkish: Japon evlerinde oda olarak kullanılan alanlar özel tatami hasırlarıyla kaplanır.

issues.englishOriginal: The traditional Japanese diet heavily features a wide variety of rice dishes, fresh seafood, noodles, and healthy soy bean products.

issues.englishOriginal: Humans also shape the land through increasing populations, agricultural expansion, mineral and forest resource excavation, changing the flow of rivers, and with layers of industrial and urban infrastructure.
issues.turkishOriginal: İnsanlar da artan nüfus, tarımsal genişleme, maden ve orman kaynağı kazısı, nehir akışını değiştirme ve endüstriyel ve kentsel altyapı katmanlarıyla araziyi şekillendirir.

issues.suggestedTurkish: İnsanlar da artan nüfus, tarımsal genişleme, maden ve orman kaynağı kazısı, nehir akışını değiştirme ve endüstriyel ve kentsel altyapı katmanlarıyla araziyi şekillendirir.

issues.englishOriginal: In many instances, the biological and physical make-up of the land contributes to how it is used; lands with rich soils are most suitable for farming while lands prone to flooding are less suitable for settlement.

issues.suggestedEnglish: In many instances, the biological and physical make-up of the land contributes to how it is used; lands with rich soils are most suitable for farming while lands prone to flooding are less suitable for settlement.
issues.suggestedTurkish: Bu nedenle, arazinin kullanılacağı amaç için en uygun olduğu yerlerde kullanılması önemlidir.

issues.englishOriginal: Large cities, for example, are often located adjacent to an ocean or river, providing essential water, and access for food, sewer, industrial, and economic purposes.

issues.suggestedEnglish: Large cities, for example, are often located beside an ocean or river, providing essential water and access for food supply, sewage disposal, industry, and economic activity.
issues.suggestedTurkish: Örneğin büyük şehirler, genellikle bir okyanus veya nehre bitişik konumlanır, temel suyu ve yiyecek, kanalizasyon, endüstriyel ve ekonomik amaçlar için erişim sağlar.
issues.reason: Repairs an incomplete list and unnatural noun phrase.

issues.englishOriginal: Land use decisions have since moved from the single farmer deciding where to place his crops to a more integrated view of land use planning.

issues.suggestedEnglish: Land-use decisions have since moved from individual farmers deciding where to place crops to a more integrated view of land-use planning.

issues.englishOriginal: One bedroom had been converted into a home for a giant fish tank containing terrapins and salamanders, while another held a pair of baby alligators.
